en.headline: Chan says carer canteens aim to spot people who need help
en.dek: A three-month trial at a Shek Pai Wan youth centre served 250 people and issued 2,200 meal coupons, the chief secretary said on Saturday.
body: Chief Secretary Eric Chan said community carer canteens are meant first to draw isolated older people, two-elderly households, people with disabilities and carers into service centres so staff can see who needs support and help prevent tragedies.

Speaking on a radio programme on Saturday, Chan said the government had already trialled the scheme for three months at a youth centre in Shek Pai Wan, Aberdeen. About 250 people used the service and 2,200 meal coupons were issued, which he described as a successful start.

The Policy Address pledged to use off-peak hours at integrated children and youth services centres to serve inexpensive, nutritious meals. Officials have said meals in the pilot were charged at about HK$10 and required a booking, rather than being free, to reduce no-shows and waste.

Chan said not every youth centre kitchen can offer the service immediately. The government would review the trial and work out how to expand it gradually across centres in the city. He separately said a two-year scheme to create 30,000 youth jobs and internships had drawn a strong response from employers.

zh.headline: 陳國基：照顧者飯堂要識別需支援人士
zh.dek: 政務司司長周六表示，香港仔石排灣青年中心試行三個月，250人使用服務，派出2,200張飯券。
body: 政務司司長陳國基表示，政府將推出的「社區照顧者飯堂」，最重要目的是吸引有需要人士走進服務中心，讓當局知道誰需要協助，有助避免悲劇發生。
他周六在電台節目說，當局已在香港仔石排灣一個青年中心試行計劃三個月，共有250人使用服務，派出2,200張飯券，形容相當成功。服務對象包括獨居長者、雙老家庭、殘疾人士及照顧者，利用綜合青少年服務中心非繁忙時段提供廉宜營養飯餐。
施政報告已公布有關措施。消息指試點每餐約10元，須預約，當局不傾向免費提供，以免有人預約後缺席造成浪費。
陳國基說，本港有多個青年中心，但並非每個中心的廚房都可以即時做到「社區照顧者飯堂」，當局會檢討及研究如何優化，令全港青年中心逐步提供有關服務。他亦提到，當局會聯同商界推出為期兩年的「三萬青年職位及實習計劃」，形容僱主反應相當好。
